qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure number for replacing the right wheel house outer section and rear side panel on convertibles?
What section reference is given for removing the right rear side panel?
qa_pairs.answer: See section 41 35 110 for removing the right rear side panel.

qa_pairs.question: What must be removed from cutting surfaces before beginning the repair work?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove anti-drumming coat on cutting surfaces.

qa_pairs.question: What method is used to separate the spot welds during this repair?
qa_pairs.answer: Drill out spot welds to separate the components.

qa_pairs.question: How should the wheel house outer section be removed after cutting?
qa_pairs.answer: Cut off wheel house outer section along line, then lift off wheel house outer section.

qa_pairs.question: What important warning is given when grinding scrap metal in the area of the top box on edge?
qa_pairs.answer: Important! Don't damage the inner wheel house panel when grinding off scrap metal.

qa_pairs.question: How many photographic steps are shown in the procedure sequence?
qa_pairs.answer: There are 6 photographic steps shown, numbered 30 41 585 through 30 41 591.

qa_pairs.question: What type of vehicle body style is this procedure specifically for?
qa_pairs.answer: This procedure is specifically for convertible body style vehicles.

qa_pairs.question: What is the main cutting technique shown for removing the outer section?
qa_pairs.answer: Cut along a predetermined line to separate the wheel house outer section from the vehicle body.

qa_pairs.question: What preparation step is required before drilling out the spot welds?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove the anti-drumming coat on cutting surfaces before drilling out the spot welds.
